newsitem.title: USA: APACHE Medical buys 2 patient data units.
newsitem.headline: APACHE Medical buys 2 patient data units.

text.p: APACHE Medical Systems Inc said on Friday it acquired Health Research Network, an information services provider, from Cognizant Corp for $1.6 million in cash.
The company also said it bought the CardioMac point of care data collection and reporting tool for the lab and cardiovascular operating room for $1.35 million and 150,000 APACHE common stock options.
On Thursday, APACHE said it expected to take a charge of between $500,000 and $800,000, or $0.07 and $0.12 per share, for its acquisition of Health Research Network.
